name: Lecture Hall Complex (LHC)
description: Primary academic complex housing large tiered lecture theatres, smart classrooms, and central photocopying facility.
directions: Central Academic Zone, adjacent to Academic Block 1.

name: Central Library
description: State-of-the-art automated library housing 50,000+ volumes, digital databases, e-journals, and 24/7 reading rooms.
directions: Opposite Administrative Building, North Campus Avenue.

name: Administrative Complex
description: Houses Director's Office, Deputy Director, Registrar, Office of Academics, Accounts, and R&D Administration.
directions: Main entry boulevard from NH-62 Main Gate.

name: Primary Health Centre (PHC)
description: 24/7 medical hospital unit with resident medical officers, emergency beds, pharmacy, and ambulance bay.
directions: Located near the residential hostel cluster.

name: Campus Sports Complex
description: Cricket ground with turf pitch, floodlit football field, synthetic basketball & tennis courts, indoor badminton halls, and athletic track.
directions: South-West campus sector near student hostels.

name: Main Entrance Gate (NH-62)
description: Primary campus checkpoint on National Highway 62, Nagaur Road, Karwar, equipped with 24/7 security control desk.
directions: 24 km north of Jodhpur Railway Station and Airport.
